plainTranslation: Feelings go to the depths. Intense emotion, old wounds surface, deep change. Let it move through; do not drown or control it.
policy: Transit-to-natal entries are ordered: transiting planet to natal planet. Do not apply same-moment aspect exclusions. Interpret as an active pressure or opening, not a guaranteed event.
note: Imported from project-authored transit-to-natal core material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
